subject: Marketplace credit top-up + PLG signup extension for CloudStore
messages:
From: Anne Park <anne.park@cloudstore.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: partner credits top-up & trial extension for CloudStore PLG signups

Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our PLG ops team. We’re seeing a spike in self-serve signups coming through CloudStore (Marketplace) and want to ensure new accounts get an extended trial so they can evaluate models without hitting cold-start limits.

Specifically: can Redwood issue a 1,000-credit top-up (one-time pool) that CloudStore team can apply to new PLG signups for the next 60 days? Ideally we’d do 100 credits per new workspace for roughly 10 immediate activations, with the remainder held for manual extensions. If possible, we’d also like the option to extend individual trials by +14 days via a promo code.

Our Marketplace listing ID: cloudstore:cs-redwood-2027. We can accept either CloudStore-issued promo codes (preferred for billing alignment) or a Redwood partner voucher bundle you generate and we distribute. We’re flexible on which path is faster.

Attached: brief Q1 usage summary so you can see the signup distribution.

Can you confirm feasibility and estimated turnaround? We’d like to launch the extension by EOD Wed (4/21).

Thanks —
Anne
Anne Park
Head of Growth, CloudStore
anne.park@cloudstore.com

Attachment: CloudStore_Usage_Summary_Q1.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anne Park <anne.park@cloudstore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner credits top-up & trial extension for CloudStore PLG signups

Hi Anne — thanks for the clear ask and the usage doc. Appreciate the timeline.

Quick answers: yes, we can support both approaches but the fastest path usually depends on which system you want to reconcile billing in (marketplace vs Redwood). Ben — can you advise whether we should: 1) create a Redwood-issued partner voucher batch that CloudStore distributes, or 2) coordinate with MarketplaceOps to generate marketplace promo codes and have CloudStore handle redemption?

Neha — looping you in for compliance: please confirm any constraints on voucher TTL, redemptions per-account, and whether a +14 day extension on trials needs a special flag in our billing system.

If we go Redwood-voucher route we can pre-generate codes today and mark them restricted to the CloudStore partner ID. If Marketplace codes are preferred, I can introduce Anne to the marketplace ops contact and request a promo batch with self-serve redemption enabled.

Next steps: Ben — can you propose a split (we typically do a 60/40 immediate/reserve for these launches) and attach the voucher manifest template so Anne can map to CloudStore workspace IDs if needed.

I’ll hold on the final plan until I hear back from you both.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Anne Park <anne.park@cloudstore.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: partner credits top-up & trial extension for CloudStore PLG signups

Thanks Sofia / Anne — I can take this on.

Proposal: issue 600 credits as immediate-distribution (60 x 10 workspaces @10 credits each — can be increased if you send workspace IDs) and reserve 400 credits for manual extensions / promo issuance. If CloudStore prefers marketplace-managed promo codes instead, we’ll hand off the manifest and you’ll get codes that reconcile to the marketplace invoice.

I’ve attached our standard voucher manifest template — please either: a) fill with workspace IDs and desired allocation and send back (we’ll generate Redwood codes), or b) confirm you want marketplace codes and I’ll submit PMB request to MarketplaceOps (+ include the allocation).

Notes:
- Voucher TTL: default 90 days (Neha: confirm if we should shorten to 60 for this program).
- Max redemptions: single-use per workspace unless Anne asks otherwise.
- Audit: all generated codes will be logged and accessible from the partner portal.

Attachment: voucher_manifest_template.csv

Anne — which path do you prefer? If you want marketplace codes I’ll open the ticket now. If you want Redwood vouchers, send the filled template and I’ll push them live today.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Partner Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: MarketplaceOps <ops@cloudmarket.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Anne Park <anne.park@cloudstore.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:17:00 +00:00
Subject: RE: Request: partner credits top-up & trial extension for CloudStore PLG signups

Hi team — MarketplaceOps here. We can generate a promo batch for CloudStore and mark it as "self-serve enabled" so promo codes can be redeemed during signup without manual intervention.

Batch details created: PMB-77821
- Total value: 1,000 credits
- Allocation: waiting on final instruction (we can pre-seed 600 active codes + 400 reserve)
- Redemption window: configurable; default 90 days (we can set 60 on request)

Next steps for CloudStore:
1) Review and e-sign the attached promo terms (link below) to allow marketplace issuance tied to your listing.
2) Confirm whether you want codes delivered as a zipped CSV to CloudStore, or if Redwood should pull codes via the partner API.

Links:
- Promo batch: https://partners.cloudmarket.io/batches/PMB-77821
- E-sign (DocuSign): https://docusign.net/Redwood_CloudStore_Promo/ABC123

Attachment: CloudStore_promo_terms_v1.pdf

We can expedite to same-day issuance once we have the signed terms and allocation confirmation.

Regards,
MarketplaceOps
Marketplace Operations Team
ops@cloudmarket.io
